name: Aurora Innovation, Inc.
moat_justification: First-mover commercial lead, a clean safety record (500,000+ driverless miles, zero Aurora-attributed collisions), and factory integration with PACCAR and Volvo are real assets, but nothing is yet durable: the fleet is ~200 trucks targeted by end-2026 so no scale/network effect exists, Kodiak/Waabi/PlusAI/Tesla are funded and deploying (Volvo also partners with Waabi), Aurora owns neither trucks nor freight demand, and the measured economics are deeply negative — roic_proxy from fundamentals.json was -33.3% (2021), -96.1% (2022), -44.5% (2023), -37.3% (2024) and -37.1% (2025), with gross margin unfiled in most years and -466.7% in FY2025 (gross profit -$14M on $3M revenue). A moat of 7+ needs ROIC well above the cost of capital through a cycle; Aurora has never printed a positive year.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
DILUTION: share count growing 17.2%/yr — already deducted via the growth adjustment; check SBC trend
BASIS_BREAK_SUSPECT: a >60% revenue jump/drop in the last 5 yrs — check for divestitures, big M&A, or restatements before trusting any CAGR
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

DEBT_TAGS_BLANK: no debt tag reports for the latest fiscal year — net debt is UNKNOWN (not zero); no leverage verdict is possible from the engine, state the balance sheet from the filing in analysis.md
one_liner: Pre-commercial autonomous-trucking leader, moat 3/10, but owner's earnings are negative on every base (TTM -$0.49/sh, 0/5 years positive) and the ~$200M/quarter burn is funded by dilution (+17.2%/yr share count) — no positive price clears the 15% hurdle until it prints a positive-OE year.
moat_for: First commercial driverless trucking on US public roads (Dallas–Houston, 2025); 500,000+ driverless miles with zero Aurora-attributed collisions
Factory OEM integration with PACCAR (Peterbilt/Kenworth) and Volvo — together roughly half the US Class 8 market
Aurora Driver data flywheel: every driverless mile trains the system rivals starting later lack
Customer/partner web: Hirschbach (500-truck Driver-as-a-Service plan from 2027), McLane, Schneider, Uber Freight, FedEx
moat_against: Fleet still tiny (200 trucks targeted by end-2026) — no scale or network effect yet
Funded rivals deploying: Kodiak, Waabi (also a Volvo partner), PlusAI, Tesla
Owns neither the trucks nor the freight demand — customers can switch autonomy suppliers
No pricing power or returns proven: ROIC proxy negative every year since 2021 (-37.1% in FY2025), FY2025 gross margin -466.7%
Continuous dilution funds the buildout — share count +17.2%/yr, SBC $205M TTM and rising
